info.title: Unicornt Store API
info.description: REST API for the Unicornt store: product catalog, cart, checkout and JWT-based authentication.

tags.name: Cart
tags.description: Shopping cart of the authenticated user

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Confirmation and history of the authenticated user's orders

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Account registration and stateless token issuing

404.description: Product, category or product type does not exist

put.summary: Set the quantity of one line of the cart; a quantity of 0 removes it

404.description: The product is not a line of the cart

delete.summary: Remove one line from the cart

404.description: The product is not a line of the cart

get.description: Returns a page of catalog products, optionally filtered by category and free text

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text matched against name and description

201.description: Product created, its URI is in the Location header

404.description: Referenced category or product type does not exist

get.summary: List the authenticated user's orders, most recent first

post.summary: Confirm the current cart as a new order
post.description: Items come from the server cart; the address is in the body. Payment is simulated.

422.description: A product of the cart is out of stock

get.description: Returns every product category ordered by name

201.description: Category created, its URI is in the Location header

409.description: A category with the same slug already exists

post.summary: Merge a local (anonymous) cart into the authenticated user's cart
post.description: For each line the new quantity is server + local, clamped to the product's stock

post.summary: Add a product to the cart, or increase the quantity of an existing line

200.description: Quantity increased on an existing line

post.description: Creates an account with a BCrypt hashed password and the ROLE_USER role

post.summary: Exchange credentials for an access token
post.description: Returns a signed JWT to be sent as an Authorization Bearer header

get.summary: Get one of the authenticated user's orders

404.description: The order does not exist or is not the caller's

get.summary: Get the cart of the authenticated user

get.description: Resolves the caller from the token in the security context

ProductUpdateRequest.description: Full replacement of an existing product

description.description: Long description shown on the product page
description.example: Cotton hoodie with an embroidered unicorn

imageBase.description: Base name of the product image file, without extension

price.description: Unit price in whole CLP units

productTypeId.description: Identifier of an existing product type

active.description: Whether the product is offered in the storefront

ErrorResponse.description: Uniform error payload returned by the API

timestamp.description: Moment the error was produced, in UTC

path.description: Request path that produced the error

errors.description: Field level errors, empty unless the failure is a validation failure

ProductResponse.description: Catalog product as exposed by the API

description.description: Long description shown on the product page
description.example: Cotton hoodie with an embroidered unicorn

imageBase.description: Base name of the product image file, without extension

price.description: Unit price in whole CLP units

categoryId.description: Identifier of the category the product belongs to

categoryName.description: Name of the category the product belongs to

active.description: Whether the product is offered in the storefront

UpdateCartItemRequest.description: New absolute quantity for an existing cart line

quantity.description: New number of units of the line; 0 removes it

productName.description: Product name at the time the cart was read

imageBase.description: Base name of the product image file, without extension

unitPrice.description: Unit price in whole CLP units

subtotal.description: Unit price multiplied by the quantity

itemCount.description: Total number of units across every line

total.description: Sum of every line subtotal, in whole CLP units

description.description: Long description shown on the product page
description.example: Cotton hoodie with an embroidered unicorn

imageBase.description: Base name of the product image file, without extension

price.description: Unit price in whole CLP units

productTypeId.description: Identifier of an existing product type

active.description: Whether the product is offered in the storefront

PlaceOrderRequest.description: Confirm the current cart into an order

total.description: Order total in whole CLP units

slug.description: URL friendly identifier; derived from the name when omitted

CategoryResponse.description: Product category as exposed by the API

MergeCartRequest.description: Local (anonymous) cart lines to fold into the user's cart

AddCartItemRequest.description: Product and units to add to the cart

productId.description: Identifier of the product to add

RegisterRequest.description: Data required to open a new account

email.description: Email, also used as the login identity

password.description: Plain password, stored hashed with BCrypt

LoginRequest.description: Credentials exchanged for an access token

TokenResponse.description: Signed access token and its lifetime

token.description: JWT to be sent as an Authorization Bearer header

totalElements.description: Total number of products across all pages

OrderLineResponse.description: A single line of a confirmed order

productName.description: Product name frozen at purchase time

unitPrice.description: Unit price frozen at purchase time, whole CLP units

subtotal.description: Unit price multiplied by the quantity

total.description: Order total in whole CLP units

createdAt.description: Moment the order was confirmed, in UTC

bearerAuth.description: JWT obtained from POST /api/v1/auth/login, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
